assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The CPT code 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to capture any underlying rhythm disturbances
The payer has denied the service under Reason Code PR-204 indicating that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
